crossRefs.note: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom.”…
crossRefs.keyword: receive, etc. Heb. weigh upon mine hand. in our hearing

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ittai
people.line: Gittite commander who remained loyal to David.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’
translations.bsb: The man replied, “Even if a thousand shekels of silver were weighed out into my hands, I would not raise my hand against the son of the king. For we heard the king command you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘Protect the young man Absalom for my sake.’
translations.kjv: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.
translations.asv: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, yet would I not put forth my hand against the king's son; for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.
